scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c magenta,green,blue "npm run db --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
